about: Earth on Aeon's 150 x 95 grid (75S-75N, column 0 from 180W, row 0 at 75N). Made by tools/earth-fetch.js.

sources.hm: ETOPO1 (NOAA NCEI), every 15', metres: land cells the mean of their land samples, sea cells of their sea samples
sources.landFrac: share of a cell's ETOPO samples above sea level
sources.tMon: CRU CL 2.0 (New et al. 2002), 1961-1990 monthly mean temperature, deg C, mean of the cell's 10' land points; null with none
sources.pMon: CRU CL 2.0, 1961-1990 monthly precipitation, mm a month, as tMon
sources.cruElev: CRU CL 2.0's elevation of the same points, metres (the height the temperatures are for)
sources.cruN: how many 10' CRU points the cell holds
sources.sstAnn: ERSST v5 1991-2020 annual mean sea surface temperature, deg C; null on land or when not downloaded
